content: Bhahe, tughaleke unyuma mabholo ghakutumbula gha Kilichitu, tujhendelele kulongela kwa mabholo ghighakomii, chi kujhendelela kubheka nchinge gwa kulekana na mahengo ghanganandela na kwa kunnyeketela Chapanga,
mabholo gha ubaticho na kubhekelwa mabhoko, kuyokechwa ku bhubhawile na luhadabulo lwa machiko ghoha ghangapeta.
Natuhenga yenio anda apahi Chapanga.
Nhwalo bhando bhubhayekulilwe uchakaka gwa Chapanga na kupaha hupo jha kunane na kulombana na Uhuke gwa Chapanga,
na kupaha umbone gwa Lilobhe lya Chapanga na makakala gha machiko ghoha ghighahika,
peniya, bhakilekite kihobholelo chabhe, bhahoto jhe kujheketele uhakaho gwabhe kabhele na kuuleka. Bheniya bhimmamba kabhele Mwana gwa Chapanga muchalaba nu kumpe hone palonge jha bhando.
Nghonda ghupoke hula machiko ghoha na umelecha mimeya kwa kichumo kwa jwailema ibhii na mota kwa Chapanga.
Nambo nn'gonda anda umelite mikongo jha mibha na maghogho, kibhii jhe chakujhambulila, libhii pahina kulapilwa na Chapanga na kujhomolela kwake ndi kujhochwa mwotu.
Nambo akakoche bhango, pamonga na kulonge naha, tubhii na kilebhe cha uchakaka mu chenie ndi ughombokeko.
Machiko ghoha Chapanga ihadabuu mbone, jwenio najhewa jhe lihengo lino na upalo gwino ghunangii kwa jwenio kwatangatii bhando bhake na ngohe chimujhendelela kwatangatila.
Twenga tupala kila mundo pakate jhino alangiye ukangamalo ade pakujhomolela, kupala lihobholelo lino libhehe chakaka.
Tupala jhe mangota mme akatotoho, nambo mme ngita bhala bhubhajheketile na bhubhabhii na luhimba, peniya, nabhapokela ghala ghalaghii Chapanga.
Lilaghilo lya Chapanga ndi lya uchakaka
Chapanga pampila Ulahimo lilaghilo, akalapii kwa liina lyake jwenio, nhwalo abhii jhe nkolongwa kuliku Chapanga kwa jwenio ngahotwi kukilapi.
Chapanga akalongii: “Chakaka nanimpela mota na kumpela ibheluko mbwe.”
Ulahimo akalendelile kwa kuhimbilila, na peniya, akapokii chela chalaghilwa na Chapanga.
Bhando pibhilapa, bhilapa kwa jhola jwabhii nkolongwa kuliku bhene, na kukilapa kulangii kubhehe chela chikilongilwe ndi uchakaka, na kukilapa kujhomo mataungano ghoha.
Na jwenio Chapanga akangamalicha lilaghano lyake kwa kulapila, kwa kutenda yenio abhalangii bhala bhabhalaghii naghalambu jhe chela chakipala.

Bhahe, ibhii ilebhe ibhele. Lilaghilo na kilapo, yenio ihoto jhe kughalambuka hilu Chapanga ihotojhe kulonge uwange. Ngohe twenga bhitubhutukile chehemo jha njelembo tulekwe mwojho gwa kukamulila njwe lihobholelo lilibhekitwe palonge jhito.
Tukwete lihobholelo lende ngita nanga jha ughome gwito. Lihobholelo lyenio lijhemite nganganga na libhii mbone lijhingii ade nkate jha panjiya na ade chehemo jha nyahinyahi kunane kwa Chapanga.
Yecho jwenio alongolile kujhingii mwenio kwa nhwalo gwito na abhile Mpiya litambiko Nkolongwa jwa machiko ghoha ghangapeta kwa nnandanikiho gwa Melikichedeki.
